debug.description: Enable debug output. Corresponds to the --debug flag.

skip_cards.description: Number of cards to skip before acting. Corresponds to the --skip flag.

commands.description: List of commands to run. Each item is a map with 'command' (string) and 'args' (list of strings). Corresponds to radeontool subcommands like 'light on/off', 'dac on/off', etc.

commands.items.description: A single command entry with its arguments. Note: type is 'object' here only for schema structure, but in values it is a flat map. The template expects 'command' and 'args'. The prompt restricts 'items' to be a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description}. Since 'args' is a list of strings, we define its content type implicitly or just define the fields. The prompt says: 'For a list-of-objects, add items as a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description}'. So I will define 'command' and 'args' here as the flat map keys for the items.

commands.items.args.description: List of arguments for the command (e.g., ['on'], ['off'], ['auto']).
